purpose: Teach: 中絶/軍備/監理/邦人/略奪/強迫/クーデター/不起訴

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、医療上の中絶事案を警察、慎重に扱われてますね
lines.en: So the police are handling medical abortion cases very carefully, aren't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly probing tone. Measured pace with a gentle upward lift at the end—genuine curiosity, not accusation. Leans slightly forward, engaged.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、地域の軍備施設の警備を担当します
lines.en: The police handle security for local military facilities as part of our duties.
lines.style: Professional and measured. Even cadence, clear enunciation. Matter-of-fact without coldness—this is simply what the work entails. Calm authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、現場の監理責任を明確にされましたね
lines.en: And in this case, you've made the on-site supervision responsibilities quite clear, haven't you?
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment with a note of confirmation. Steady, slightly slower pace. Gentle emphasis on 'clear'—appreciative rather than interrogative.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、邦人の海外被害事案も対応します
lines.en: The police also respond to cases involving Japanese citizens harmed overseas.
lines.style: Straightforward statement of fact. Even breathing, professional tone. No flourish—just information delivered with quiet competence and seriousness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、文化財略奪の容疑を捜査されてますね
lines.en: So the police are also investigating suspicions of cultural property theft, I understand?
lines.style: Thoughtful inquiry with respect for the scope of work. Slight pause before speaking. Warm but serious—acknowledging the weight of such investigations.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、強迫罪の事件は厳しく対応します
lines.en: The police treat extortion cases with the utmost seriousness.
lines.style: Firm resolve beneath a steady exterior. Slight hardening on 'utmost seriousness'—conviction without aggression. This matters, and everyone should know it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、海外のクーデター情報も警察、把握されてますね
lines.en: Even information about overseas coups—the police keep track of that too, don't they?
lines.style: Slightly impressed, probing gently. Measured pace with curiosity rising toward the end. Respectful tone—acknowledging the scope and complexity of police work.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不起訴処分の理由を市民に説明します
lines.en: When we decide not to prosecute, we explain the reasoning to the public.
lines.style: Warm and open, with quiet conviction. Slower, deliberate pace. This is important—transparency matters. Direct eye contact level steady; a personal commitment, not just protocol.
